hero.heading: From concept to launch, legacy to cloud
hero.description: Four ways to engage Ternary, one standard of engineering. We design, build, modernize, and run digital systems as long-term stewards, accountable for how they perform and evolve over years.

cards.title: Product Development
cards.description: End-to-end product engineering from conception to scale. We design, build, and launch digital products that users rely on and businesses depend on.

cards.title: Enterprise Modernization
cards.description: Modernizing legacy systems for the digital age, with cloud-native architectures, modern data platforms, and scalable operations.

cards.title: Engineering Augmentation
cards.description: Extending your team with specialized talent. Experienced engineers who integrate seamlessly into your workflows and culture.

cards.title: Managed Services
cards.description: Sustained production responsibility for the systems we ship. We support deployments, monitor reliability, and keep platforms performing over time.

section_2.title: Products engineered for longevity, not just launch
section_2.description: With a product-first mindset, we deliver applications, platforms, and services engineered for longevity, performance, and measurable business impact. Our holistic approach covers the full product lifecycle: strategy, design, build, and scale.
section_2.whoDescription: Founders and product leaders taking a concept to launch, from early-stage MVPs to scale-ups expanding their first products into durable platforms.
section_2.shapeDescription: Strategy and roadmaps, intuitive UI/UX and user testing, robust engineering, and the launch and scaling of products built to perform reliably and evolve thoughtfully.

section_3.title: Legacy to cloud, without losing control
section_3.description: We help organizations move from fragmented, legacy, or experimental environments to modern, resilient platforms that scale with confidence. Our approach balances innovation with pragmatism, from monolithic to microservices and on-premise to cloud.
section_3.whoDescription: Mid-market and enterprise organizations modernizing critical systems where governance, reliability, and continuity cannot be compromised.
section_3.shapeDescription: Cloud-native architectures, modern data platforms, and scalable operations, delivered through complex technical transitions that produce measurable value and long-term success.

section_4.title: Specialized talent that integrates seamlessly
section_4.description: Scale your team with experienced engineers who integrate into your existing workflows and culture. We extend your capacity with specialized expertise, not just additional headcount.
section_4.whoDescription: Engineering and product leaders who need to fill skill gaps, scale capacity, or add specialized expertise without slowing delivery.
section_4.shapeDescription: Embedded engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and data, working inside your processes and accountable to your standards from day one.

section_5.title: Production responsibility across the lifecycle
section_5.description: We maintain full production responsibility for the systems we deliver, actively supporting deployments and remaining accountable for sustained performance. This is software treated as long-term stewardship.
section_5.whoDescription: Organizations that need the systems they depend on to stay reliable, observed, and well-maintained long after launch.
section_5.shapeDescription: Reliability monitoring, incident response, ongoing maintenance, and the disciplined operations that keep mission-critical platforms performing and evolving.

engage.heading: Engagement Models
engage.description: Three engagement models, one commitment to outcomes. Choose the structure that fits the work, and keep the same engineering standard across all of them.

cards.title: Frame™
cards.subtitle: Fixed scope
cards.description: Fixed scope, timeline, and price for discrete projects with well-understood objectives, such as product launches, system migrations, platform implementations, and proofs of concept.

cards.title: Flow™
cards.subtitle: Continuous delivery
cards.description: A dedicated team working iteratively to build and evolve your product, ideal for long-term development, continuous feature delivery, and market-responsive iteration.

cards.title: Orchestra™
cards.subtitle: On-demand talent
cards.description: Technical talent integrated into your existing workflows on demand, ideal for filling skill gaps, scaling capacity, and adding specialized expertise with flexible resourcing.

cta.heading: Let's build something built to last
cta.description: Tell us what you're shaping, and we'll bring the engineering ownership to see it through, from first concept to sustained production.
